headline: Sep 14 AM · Monday opens with the tiebreaker answered in the worst possible way: the Sep 13 digest DID land (15:00:08Z, the only new mail overnight) and it is digit-for-digit the same nine numbers for a fifth straight day — 0 new, 0 booked, 3 breached, 3 unbooked, 0% booking. A digest that cannot change cannot tell a true standstill from a stale read, so the scoreboard is now formally uninformative; the only instrument left is a human opening the CRM, and that one look also settles the spend-sync question (w30). Around it nothing moved: FA-ADS watchdog dark ~85h, sync alarm silent ~65h with zero successes ever, Mary Grossman into her third day past the callback with no called / referred / held on record, compliance 0/7 on day 18 of live consumer leads.

spotlight.title: Open the CRM — one human look replaces two dead instruments
spotlight.detail: The digest answered last night's question with the same nine numbers for a fifth day, which means it can no longer distinguish 'nothing happened' from 'reading a frozen table.' One minute in the CRM settles both open unknowns at once: (a) are there ad-spend rows stamped after Sep 11 13:32Z — w30, the sync question; (b) do the lead rows actually show 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9. Write the two answers into the board. Do not infer either from silence.

spotlight.title: Mary Grossman — third day past the window, sixth ask
spotlight.detail: Fri 6:45 PM PT callback is now into its third day gone. The Sep 12 AND Sep 13 digests both put the miss on the system of record (3 unbooked, 3 SLA breached, 0 booked). First real $300-Plan lead (NV), NO TCPA consent, hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. Monday is the first business-day chance to close it honestly: one sentence in a lane — called / referred / held. It stays on the record until a human writes it.

spotlight.title: Day 18 of live consumer leads, 0/7 compliance, and the watchdog has now been dark 85 hours
spotlight.detail: Consumer flow went live Aug 27; eighteen days later none of the seven blockers is closed — b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer license #) are the two that gate the lead in hand. Meanwhile the FA-ADS watchdog has not run since Sep 10 17:06Z (~85h), so V2 spend (last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche) has had no reader for three and a half days. Either state the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold — or restore what the watchdog runs on. Letting it drain by default is the one choice the board cannot accept.

blockers.label: Scoreboard frozen · 5th day
blockers.detail: Sep 13 digest (15:00:08Z) is identical to Sep 10, 11 and 12: 0 new, 0 booked, 3 breached, 3 with contact, 3 unbooked, 0%, 4 partials, 135 min median reply, 0 opted out. The digest is now formally uninformative — only a direct CRM read can say whether anything moved.

blockers.label: Mary Grossman
blockers.detail: First real $300-Plan lead (NV). Callback window (Fri 6:45 PM PT) now into its third day past; Sep 12 + Sep 13 digests both confirm 0 booked / 3 unbooked / 3 SLA breached. No TCPA consent → hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. Owed in writing, sixth ask: called / referred / held.

blockers.label: FA-ADS watchdog dark ~85h
blockers.detail: No watchdog run since Sep 10 17:06Z. The digest lane fires daily at 15:00Z, so this is one specific lane down, not a blanket credit blackout. V2 spend last read ~$72 of the $200 tranche and has had no interpreter for three and a half days.

blockers.label: Spend sync silent ~65h
blockers.detail: Meta→CRM ad-spend sync 403-failed 14× (Sep 11 00:32Z→13:32Z, egress allowlist) then went quiet — no failure and no success since. It has never sent a success notice, so quiet ≠ fixed. w30: open the CRM, look for spend rows after Sep 11 13:32Z.

blockers.label: Cost per booked call unmeasurable
blockers.detail: Still never measured. ~$360 lifetime spend, 0 confirmed booked calls, and the feed that would connect the two has been broken since Aug 27 — the day real leads started arriving.

blockers.detail: b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) + b7 (CA producer license #) unclosed on day 18 of live consumer lead flow. The one real lead (NV) sits behind this gate while every notification says "call fast."

blockers.label: Meeting ingest 25d stale
blockers.detail: Fathom/TwinMind ingest stuck at Aug 20. Fix is to run the task where a bridge exists and wire TurboScribe as a transcript route — it keeps producing files while the MCP ingest stays dead.

A founder's call; the board only carries it so it does not get lost.

tasks.detail: Window now into its third day past (Fri 6:45 PM PT); Sep 12 and Sep 13 digests both confirm 0 booked / 3 unbooked / 3 breached. No TCPA consent → hand-dial only +1 805 302 2655. One sentence in a lane: called / referred / held. Sixth ask.

tasks.detail: Day 18 of live consumer lead flow, still 0/7. The NV lead sits behind this gate; TX dialing needs the telephone-solicitor registration and CA needs the producer license number.

tasks.lead: State the paid motion plainly — keep spending or hold
tasks.detail: V2 tranche last read ~$72 of $200 before the watchdog went quiet ~85h ago, and cost per booked call has never been measured. Decide explicitly rather than letting the budget drain by default with no interpreter watching it.

tasks.lead: Restore whatever the watchdog runs on
tasks.detail: The digest fires daily at 15:00Z but the FA-ADS watchdog has been dark ~85h — a specific lane fault, not a blanket outage. Confirm credits/access and get the interpreter back.
One session unblocks four things: founder ad creative, a creative with his face, the landing-page refresh, and the ElevenLabs voice clone. Shirt + tie, iPhone 4K/60fps, ~20-24 min of takes.

tasks.lead: Open the CRM and answer two questions in one look
tasks.detail: (a) w30: any ad-spend rows timestamped after Sep 11 13:32Z? Rows → the 403 cleared; none → the sync task died. (b) Do the lead rows really read 3 with contact / 3 unbooked / 3 breached, or has the table not been written since Sep 9? The digest can no longer tell — a fifth identical day makes it formally uninformative.

The digest firing on time again last night proves the AI path is not universally dead. Treat the watchdog as its own failure (~85h dark) and find what it is missing — credits, schedule, or a silent crash.

tasks.lead: Make the digest able to change
tasks.detail: If the CRM read shows the table is stale, the digest is reading a frozen source and needs a freshness stamp (last row written) in its header so a frozen read is visible as frozen. If the table is live, the 0% booking rate is real and the number the whole motion is judged on.
Test lead reached the CRM but W1 never sent the welcome email. A lead can currently land and receive nothing — independent of the sync break.

tasks.lead: Wire TurboScribe as a transcript route
tasks.detail: Meeting ingest is 25 days stale at Aug 20 while TurboScribe keeps producing transcripts. Route them in rather than waiting on the Fathom/TwinMind bridge.

Digest alive (fired Sep 12 and Sep 13 at 15:00Z), watchdog dark ~85h, sync ambiguous ~65h. Do not let the record slide back to "all AI lanes dead" — it is one confirmed-dark lane plus one silence that was never a success signal.

tasks.lead: Log the scoreboard as uninformative, not as 'nothing happened'
tasks.detail: Five identical digests in a row is a property of the instrument, not a fact about the funnel. The record says 'unknown until the CRM is read directly' — never 'quiet'.

tasks.lead: Hold Mary's window as a miss, not an open task
tasks.detail: Sixth ask. It stays on the record as an unrecorded outcome until a human writes called / referred / held — it does not quietly age out of the board.
AM edition generated → curated → synced → published → verified → logged. Seventh consecutive session with a working cloud→Mac bridge.
